title: Fleet & Roster - today vs proposed (strike what you don't want)
sub: Lab, big demo company (24 people, 2 areas), Sunday. Left of each arrow = the app today. Right = proposed, running in the lab only - nothing proposed is live. Checked as the owner (Hartono), the regional admin (Hendra) and a salesman (Dika: he has no Fleet screen, on purpose). Numbers are measured in the page, not guessed.

sections.h: 1. Who leads the team - owner on the PC, Bandung tab

pair.cap: Today. Dewi Lestari, Bandung's regional admin, is the 13th card - on page 2, no crown. The HQ sales manager gets a crown and goes first. Hendra (regional admin, HQ) is 9th, page 2 of his own roster.
Proposed. Dewi first, with a crown. On the HQ tab: Rina (HQ sales manager) first, Hendra second, both crowned. Salesmen keep their order.

sections.h: 2. Regional admin on the phone (390 px) - the first screen, nobody picked yet

pair.cap: Today. The title is cut: "HEADQUARTERS l" (needs 240 px, has 175). "11 · 8 vans loaded" takes 2 lines. Page keys 1 2 AND a sideways swipe move the same cards. Hendra himself is on page 2.

Proposed. OFFERS shows its gift icon only on the phone, so the title fits (225 of 225 px - a longer area name still ends in …). One line under it. No page keys: one swipe row of all 11. The whole screen fits without scrolling.

items.cap: Today, one scroll down: PEOPLE 11 and VANS LOADED 8 / 11 - the line under the title already says both. Proposed keeps only BKS IN THE VANS and OVERRIDE REQUESTS (right frame above).

sections.h: 3. Loading Bagus's van on the phone - the regional admin's main job
sections.note: Tap 1 = a box in the warehouse. Tap 2 = a square in the van. Then HOW MANY, then MUAT VAN. Nothing about the chests changes; only where the screen goes.

pair.cap: Today, after tap 1. "dipilih · ketuk kotak di van" - but the van's empty square is at 886 px, under the 844 px screen. He has to find it.
Proposed, after tap 1. The screen glides down to the van. The empty square (gold dashes) is at 438 px, ready for tap 2.
Today, after MASUKKAN 100 BKS. The screen goes back up to the warehouse. The muatan list and MUAT VAN are under the screen (1,062 px). Nothing on screen says a load is waiting.
Proposed. A gold bar at the bottom: "Muatan · 1 barang · +100 Bks · LIHAT". It only scrolls - MUAT VAN still moves the stock, so it is still pressed where the list can be read.

items.cap: Proposed - one press on the bar. The list and "MUAT VAN · 100 BKS MASUK" are on screen (501 px); the bar goes away. On the PC nothing changes - there the list sits beside the chests.

sections.h: 4. The list under the van (Itemized Asset Ledger)

pair.cap: Today. Each loaded row says one number twice: "Active Load: 300 Bks" and "LEFT: 300".
Proposed. "Active Load" only shows when the van holds that item in Slop or Bal (then it is new news). The page is 105 px shorter (2,609 → 2,504).

sections.h: 5. Found, but not on this board
sections.note: "VAN · VAN" under the van chest: the demo puts the word Van where the number plate goes - a demo-data fix, not the screen. Two languages on one screen (the chests in Indonesian, the roster in English) - that belongs to the language switch job. Demo only: the top of the HOW MANY box (the item's photo and name) sits under the DEMO strip on the phone - I will measure it before proposing anything.
